_comment: CSS selectors for Craigslist scraping. Each key has a 'selector' (used by BeautifulSoup) and an 'intent' (used by Claude to find a replacement if the selector breaks).

listing_cards.intent: Each <li> element representing a single Craigslist listing card in the search results page. Contains the title, URL, price, and location of one listing.

listing_title.intent: The title text of a listing card — the main headline the poster wrote. Usually inside a <span> nested inside the anchor link of the card.

listing_url.intent: The href attribute on the anchor link of a listing card that leads to the full individual listing page on Craigslist.

listing_price.intent: The price shown on the listing card. May be empty or missing if the poster did not include a price.

listing_location.intent: The neighborhood or city/location tag shown below the listing title on the card.

listing_date.intent: The post date of the listing. Often stored as a title attribute on the meta span element on the card.

next_page.intent: The pagination button or link to navigate to the next page of search results. Usually labeled 'next' or contains a right arrow.

article_body.intent: The full text body of an individual Craigslist listing page — the description the poster wrote. Usually inside a <section> or <div> with id 'postingbody'.

article_contact_phone.intent: A tel: link containing the poster's phone number on the individual listing page. Only present if the poster chose to display their phone number.

article_reply_email.intent: The reply link on an individual listing page. On Craigslist this is usually an anonymized email link (mailto: or a /reply/ URL). Used to obtain a contact email.

article_post_date.intent: The datetime attribute on the <time> element inside the post date area of an individual listing page. Contains an ISO 8601 date string.
